query_plan.query: Which continent has the second largest total population?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by continent, return the continent with the second largest total population.
steps.query: Return all continents with their population.

extra.sql_query: SELECT continents.name FROM continents WHERE continents.population = ( SELECT MAX(continents.population) FROM continents WHERE continents.population <> ( SELECT MAX(continents.population) FROM continents ) )
